cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.21)
project(binary_symbols_check CXX)
set(ENGINE_NAME binary_symbols_base)
add_library(binary_symbols_base STATIC base.cpp)
if(PACKAGE_CONFIG)
    include("${PACKAGE_CONFIG}")
    add_executable(binary_symbols_consumer main.cpp)
    target_link_libraries(binary_symbols_consumer PRIVATE binary_symbols)
else()
    include("${PLUGIN_SOURCE}/native/windows/binary_symbols-config.cmake")
    set(CC_REGISTERED_PLUGINS binary_symbols)
    include("${BINARY_METADATA_MODULE}")
endif()
